entries.7c95a2dbfb4c6979: It is a manufacturer headquartered in Osaka City that makes and sells prescription drugs and medical devices and equipment, including injectable drugs such as infusion solutions and the dialysis agent Kindaly for artificial kidneys, and also undertakes contract manufacturing of pharmaceuticals.
entries.7e074c53defb89f3: It handles products in the assisted reproductive technology (ART) field, such as tissue culture media for in vitro fertilization, and has unified the brand under 'HiGROW'.
entries.838f61f8035c75fb: In dialysis agents for artificial kidneys, the company has a track record dating back to 1964, when it began supplying the first dialysis fluid in Japan, and dialysis-related products centered on its flagship product Kindaly form the core of its business. It handles many basic pharmaceuticals and supply-securing pharmaceuticals essential to the provision of medical care, and has put in place a system for stable supply.
entries.8ac791aba1251ab0: Of revenue of ¥62,307 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026, prescription drugs and medical devices and equipment accounted for ¥59,499 million, and other revenue, including fees from contract manufacturing and co-promotion agreements and real estate rental, was ¥2,808 million. Sales are made through pharmaceutical wholesalers, and the main counterparties are Suzuken (18.7% of total sales), Alfresa (18.0%), Medeceo (15.6%) and Toho Yakuhin (11.7%).

entries.d0d8fd4a34fb2d5b: Its medium-term management policy, "FUSO Vision 2030 Next Stage" (announced in August 2025), states that the company aims to become a company that supports society through healthcare, as a specialty pharma addressing unmet medical needs in the kidney and urology fields, while operating as a basic pharmaceutical manufacturer that carries out thorough quality control and sustainable stable supply. The company will promote five basic policies: research and development (including development of DMX-200, an FSGS therapeutic), production (including construction of the Okayama Second Plant and reorganization of production sites), sales and marketing, DX of its management systems, and human capital and sustainability.
